Companion Animal Travel Desk service rules

This section covers how staff book, review, and hand off animal travel requests for Aurelia Skyways. The desk keeps the process calm, clear, and humane at every step, and staff must match that tone with travelers and handlers alike. Each booking starts with a full check of the travel note, crate fit, and route conditions, then moves to the senior coordinator only when the case needs extra review.

Staff must use plain language, confirm traveler details carefully, and avoid rushed promises. If a case involves a small dog, <<FACT F074>>. For large dog cases, <<FACT F081>>. If the traveler asks about charges, <<FACT F057>>. Do not guess, round, or offer side comments around any inserted rule. Keep the record clean, and make sure the companion animal file matches the approved service path before anything is confirmed.

When an animal seems uneasy, the desk should slow the exchange, keep noise down, and use the gentlest workable steps. If a booking does not fit the normal path, staff should pass it upward in a calm sequence rather than debate it at the counter. The desk never pressures the traveler, never improvises missing documents, and never skips the senior coordinator when a review is needed.

For any unclear case, contact the senior coordinator or the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
